system.monsterType: Monster (Common).,A black pudding is a nonintelligent black,blob 5 to 30 feet in diameter. Puddings are al-,ways hungry; they will attack any creature they,come across.
system.description: With their corrosive touch, they inflict 3d8 points of damage to living things, and can dis- solve wood and corrode metal in one turn. They cannot affect stone. They can travel on ceilings and walls, and can pass through small openings. (Passing through a small opening is very slow and usually takes a full turn or longer.) A pudding can only be killed by fire; other at- tacks (weapons or spells) merely break it up into smaller puddings, each with 2 Hit Dice and in- flicting ld8 points of damage per blow. How- ever, a flaming sword will cause full normal damage. Puddings normally have no treasure, but gems (the only remnants of previous victims) might be found nearby.
